title: BandParityTower: the band-parity tower and its limit modulo eight
abstract: For a prime p let a = v_2(p-1), m = (p-1)/2^a, H_a the subgroup of (Z/p)^x of order m and s(x) = (-1)^<x>. The development proves the tower of band-parity laws of Paper I of the author's series: the cyclotomic tower (every coordinate of the band-parity sum of the character of order 2^a is congruent modulo 4 to an explicit count), the band-parity tower f_a = sum over H_a of s(u) s(u^2) = m (mod 4) at every odd prime, the doubling count sum over 2H_a of s(u) s(2u) = 2 N_a - m, the imaginary law e_a = 2 N_a - m (mod 4) at every prime p = 1 (mod 4) with its level-3 form, the collapse e_a = +-f_a when 2 is a 2^(a-1)-th power residue, and E. Lehmer's criterion for 2 to be a 2k-th power residue. It also proves the power-map family, the companion law Re C = Im C = kappa (mod 4) at p = 1 (mod 8), and Lehmer-type invariants of the inversion map modulo 4; and, modulo 8, the joint-parity form, the dichotomy, squaring cycles and the order-three pair, the defect lemma, odd multipliers as floor sums and the fifth-interval formula linking M_H(5) to B_{1,theta_p}.
